title: INT8 encoder causal-zero convolution follow-up
implementation: Unreleased working-tree follow-up; exact source hashes in formal_full_video
gpu_identity: RTX PRO 5000 72GB historical identity; driver reports NVIDIA Graphics Device / SM120

formal_full_video.scope:
Full-video same-compiled-graph A/B for causal-zero INT8 conv skipping.

Only the opaque fused norm's quantized-convolution dispatch varies. The
producer, quantization, norm, static weights, compiler graph and runtime
outputs are common. Compilation, model loading, media I/O and verification
are excluded from timing; dynamic quantization and allocations are included.
Private paths and raw media never enter the repository from this experiment.
notes: Same compiled graph and immutable weights; only opaque quantized conv kernel differs.
Norm producer is unchanged; both candidates see the same quantization contract.
Peak allocated bytes include retained validation outputs, not isolated model VRAM.
No validation synchronization inside timed hot paths.
Other GPU work was not stopped; raw timing samples are retained.
Synthetic replay and shadow checks are not substitutes for full video quality.

baseline_nsight_reference.note: Historical independent process for attribution only; paired full-stage speedup comes from formal_full_video.

micro_replay.scope:
Limited exact replay of current INT8 conv versus known-zero causal skipping.

Uses synthetic quantized input at captured H3 shapes. Dynamic quantization,
producer, allocation, model execution, media, and compilation are excluded
from micro timing; this is not an end-to-end performance claim.

settings.input_prefix: first two temporal planes exactly zero
settings.sampling: alternate AB / BA, keep all samples

norm_2d_broadcast.decision: Not promoted: only 2-4% local gain, insufficient full-stage budget; no full encode speedup claimed

decoder_gemm_swiglu.status: Not integrated: the recombined compiled baseline failed equality against production; no valid full-decode speedup established

micro_replay.scope: Captured real FFN-up complete GEMM + SwiGLU + row INT8 quantization; not full decode

no_partial_replay.scope: complete captured FFN-up GEMM + SwiGLU quantization; one variable: partial max

invalid_first_full_attempt.reason: Recompiling the same module after changing its class forward reused the original Dynamo graph. Replaced by independent block type plus reset and mandatory hit checks.

full_attempt.reason: The recombined baseline executed 1764 opaque calls across 36 weights but output differed from production; candidate timing and shadow validation were not reached.

default_fp16_finalizer.decision: Not integrated: only 9.9-13.2 ms local savings; no full-decode timing. Fastest existing fused FP16/INT8 profiles already use this finalizer. Local allocation savings do not establish full-runtime peak savings.

comfy.scope: compiled Comfy wrapper smoke; random tensors, not quality

input.raw_normalized_contract: same torch.float32 Comfy IMAGE movedim(-1,1)->movedim(1,0)->unsqueeze(0), process_input (* 2 - 1), then cast FP16

notes: Eight encoder INT8 Conv3d leaves and 72 decoder INT8 linear leaves are required.
qweight and FP32 scale device/dtype are checked before offload, on CPU, and after full CUDA reload.
Comfy wrapper encode compares against raw runtime using identical FP16-normalized RGB values.
Decoder comparison reshapes wrapper BTHWC output to raw runtime BCTHW.
Raw/wrapper compatibility is required to be finite, shape-matched, and exact; before/after metrics are reported without a zero assertion because offload algorithms may change.
Random inputs/latents prove wrapper plumbing only; they are not image/video quality evidence.
When --encoded-roundtrip is set, the report also checks decode of the actual FP16-cast wrapper.encode latent; this is a finite shape smoke, not quality evidence.

limitations: FP16 default and decoder runtime unchanged by causal-zero work. Original INT8 quality loss remains.
Only the existing SM120 automatic norm-producer path enables skipping; generic inputs and unsupported loop geometries use the full INT8 reduction.
Other GPU tasks stayed running; all GPU experiments serialized with a cooperative lock.
Three main ABBA/BAAB blocks plus one independent-width block are bounded full-stage validation, not ACA six-block/three-seed full-workflow confirmation.
No NCU hardware counters: earlier access failed with ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM. Nsight durations do not establish hardware bandwidth or stall causes.
